fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: ctor stores 0x191be0; PS2 keeps its vptr at the END (+0x3c, ctor sw vtable_RSceneObj,0x3c), which is why every PS2 field sits 4 bytes lower than Xbox

fields.name: next
fields.evidence: SetMapNode/UseInstanceList/~RSceneObj: doubly linked list headed at MapNode+4, new obj inserted at head (next=old head); DestroySceneObjectList/InitializeSceneObjectListLighting walk +4; dtor poisons it 0xabababab. PS2 +0x0

fields.name: prev
fields.evidence: SetMapNode clears it on insert and fixes next->prev (+8); dtor unlinks via +4/+8. PS2 +0x4

fields.name: sourceInstance
fields.evidence: POINTER, not a copy: ctor stores its CARP::Instance& arg (param_1_00[3]=param_1) and only copies it to a stack MATRIX4. 64-byte record: rows 0-3 are the transform, word +0x3c packs the bounding radius ((v&0x3ff)*table[bit30], bit31=compute), byte +0xc bit3 feeds flags bit2. GetTransform/GetPosition/Render/GetBoundingRadius/GetViewDistance read it; RAutonomousObj points it at its own +0x40. PS2 +0x8 = SourceInstance() accessor

fields.name: baseDesc
fields.evidence: PS2 GetBaseDesc returns PS2 +0xc. Set in UseInstanceList from *(article+0x1c); *baseDesc is the model UGroup (SetVariation/GetViewDrawList/GetNumBones/GetBoneIndex/Reset); +4 flags (0x2000 = skip lighting), +0x10/+0x20 bbox min/max (GetBoundingDimensions), +0x3c/+0x60 collision geometry (GetCollisionGeometry)

fields.name: carpFile
fields.evidence: PS2 GetCARPFile returns PS2 +0x10. Load stores the URefCounter<RCARPFile> reference here; ~RSceneObj/Load RemoveReference it and FastFree(..,0x38)

fields.name: mapNode
fields.evidence: SetMapNode(CARP::MapNode*) stores its arg here after unlinking from the old node; UpdatePosition passes it to WTree::FindNode as the search start; UseInstanceList sets it to the world-tree root when flags bit2. PS2 +0x14 (SetMapNode)

fields.name: renderTypeIndex
fields.evidence: ctor zeroes it; no Xbox RSceneObj method reads it. PS2 GetRenderTypeIndex/SetRenderTypeIndex = lbu/sb PS2 +0x18 (byte 0 of the PS2 bitfield word at +0x18)

fields.name: variation
fields.evidence: SetVariation stores (char)arg on success; Reset passes it to UseArticle; UseArticle writes it. PS2 GetVariation = lbu PS2 +0x19

fields.name: brightness
fields.evidence: ctor sets 100. PS2 Brightness() = lbu PS2 +0x1a * (1/255); SetBrightness(float) clamps 0..1, *255, sb PS2 +0x1a; PS2 ctor also sb 100 there

fields.name: flags
fields.evidence: Show/Hide bit0; ctor does &0xe1|1 (clears bits1-4, sets visible). On PS2 these are bits 24-28 of the word at PS2 +0x18 (Show/Hide = or/and 0x01000000, IsVisible = lb +0x1b &1)

bits.name: visible
bits.evidence: Show/Hide; SetNowVisible/SetSceneObjectCull only list visible objects. PS2 IsVisible/Show/Hide bit 24

bits.name: allInstancesSimple (unknown)
bits.evidence: UseInstanceList sets it, then clears it if any anim-handle instance node's flag byte (+0x4c) has neither 0x01 nor 0x40; GetNextSceneObjCullInfo returns 0.3 in its last float& when set, 1.0 otherwise. PS2 bit 25, no accessor

bits.name: inRootNode (unknown)
bits.evidence: UseInstanceList copies CARP::Instance flag byte +0xc bit3 here and, when set, puts the object in the world-tree root node; UpdatePosition then skips re-bucketing and lighting; GetNextSceneObjCullInfo's bool& = !bit2. PS2 bit 26, no accessor

bits.name: drawLast
bits.evidence: SetNowVisible/SetSceneObjectCull put the object on the draw-last list (RenderAllDrawLast/RenderAllDeferredEffects); UseInstanceList sets it when baseDesc byte +0x1e==1. PS2 DrawLast(bool) writes bit 27

bits.name: isVehicle
bits.evidence: no Xbox RSceneObj use beyond the ctor clearing it; PS2 IsVehicle = (word+0x18 >> 28)&1, SetVehicle sets 0x10000000 = byte bit 4

bits.name: unused
bits.evidence: never touched by the ctor or any RSceneObj method

fields.name: damagedZones
fields.evidence: PS2 GetDamagedZones = lhu PS2 +0x1c. TriggerFX type 10 feeds the newly set bits to RAnimEngine::Handle::ProcessStimuliZones(0x12,..) and stores the mask; RenderEffects skips an effect whose zone (effect byte +0x16) bit is set here unless the effect has flag 0x2000; UseInstanceList zeroes it

fields.name: damageEffectZones
fields.evidence: TriggerFX type 9: if new bits, DamageEffects(this+0x22 | mask) then ORs mask in; UseInstanceList zeroes it. PS2 +0x1e (TriggerFX uses it the same way); no PS2 accessor, name invented

fields.name: effectDecayTime
fields.evidence: TriggerEffects/DamageEffects/DecayEffects set it to frame counter DAT_001f2a4c+600 while any effect is active, 0 otherwise; RenderEffects calls DecayEffects once the counter passes it. PS2 +0x20 (RenderEffects field9_0x20). Name invented

fields.name: physics
fields.evidence: SetPhysics(PhysicsObject*) stores here; PS2 GetPhysics (both overloads) = lw PS2 +0x24. UpdatePosition/GetVelocity/SetTransform/EnableTarget/SetEventDynamicData read +0x48 bit0 (simple body) and short +0x4a (rigid body index)

fields.name: animHandle
fields.evidence: UseInstanceList stores RAnimEngine::Handle::Create(...); dtor/Load/UseInstanceList Stop and operator_delete(..,0x40). The effect state lives in the handle: effects array +0x14, zone-mask ushort array +0x18, instance count byte +0x1c, numEffects byte +0x1f, 64-bit effect masks +0x20/+0x28/+0x30/+0x38, instance nodes from +0x40 stride 0x40. PS2 GetAnimHandle = lw PS2 +0x28

fields.name: pathHandle
fields.evidence: ctor stores RPathEngine::GetPathHandle(instance); GetVelocity returns pathHandle+0x88 when there is no physics. PS2 GetPathHandle = lw PS2 +0x2c

fields.name: target
fields.evidence: EnableTarget FastAlloc(0x50,'WTargetable') and stores it; SetPhysics/~RSceneObj RemoveReference and clear it. PS2 +0x30 (DisableTarget clears PS2 +0x30)

fields.name: collisionInfo
fields.evidence: AddCollisionInfo lazily __builtin_new(0x20)s it: {COORD3 pointSum; uint frame; COORD3 normalSum; uint count}; GetCollisionInfo averages it for the current frame or deletes it; dtor/UseInstanceList delete it. PS2 +0x34. Struct type name invented

fields.name: name
fields.evidence: UseInstanceList stores its name arg or '<<unknown>>' (UseInstance passes '<<fragment1>>', UseArticle the article's 'Name' tag). PS2 +0x38 (UseInstanceList piVar5[0xe]). No accessor; debug name

fields.name: instance
fields.evidence: every allocation site (Grenade 0x5d728, Mine, Missile, Newton, ~ESpawnSmackable) copies the identity matrix to this+0x40 then calls RSceneObj(this+0x40), so sourceInstance points at this embedded 64-byte record: the object owns its own instance/transform. Typed MATRIX4 in the current header; CARP::Instance (MATRIX4-shaped, radius packed in the last word) is more accurate. PS2 RAutonomousObj has only its dtor (FastFree 0x80)

fields.name: params
fields.evidence: ctor zeroes 12 dwords; SetProcAnimState calls SetProcAnimParamList(this+0x40,12). PS2 GetParam(i) = this+0x40+4*i (same offset on PS2)

fields.name: springEffectMask
fields.evidence: PostLoad ORs 1<<i for every anim-handle effect of type 8; UpdatePosition walks its set bits and runs UpdateSpringMassSystem for each. PS2 sd zero,0x70 / PostLoad same. Name invented

fields.name: numBones
fields.evidence: AllocateSkeleton stores the count; dtor frees bones with size numBones<<6. PS2 NumBones = lw +0x78

fields.name: bones
fields.evidence: AllocateSkeleton FastAlloc(n*0x40,'Bones') and inits each to identity; SetProcAnimState passes (bones,numBones) to SetProcAnimXFormList; UpdatePosition writes bone[id-1]. PS2 GetBone(i) = *(+0x7c)+(i-1)*0x40

fields.name: springPrevPos
fields.evidence: ctor sets (0,0,0,-1); UpdateSpringMassSystem treats w==-1 as 'uninitialised' (resets both to (0,0,0,1)), then shifts +0x90 into +0x80 each step. PS2 same offset. Name invented

fields.name: springPos
fields.evidence: ctor (0,0,0,-1); UpdateSpringMassSystem stores the new spring point here after velocity from (+0x90 - +0x80). PS2 same offset. Name invented

notes: Offset rule: Xbox = PS2 + 4 for every RSceneObj field, because GCC 2.95 put the vptr last (PS2 +0x3c) and MSVC puts it first. Both are 0x40 bytes, so subclass fields (RSkeletalObj +0x40..+0x9f) have the SAME offsets on both builds.

Xbox vtable slot i = PS2 vtable entry i+1 (PS2 entry 0 is the type_info function; 8-byte GCC entries). 19 slots (0x4c bytes); the float 1.4f at 0x191c2c after them is not a slot. Virtual calls agree: +0x1c slot 7 TransformPointToWorldSpace, +0x20 slot 8 TransformMatrixToWorldSpace, +0x28 slot 10 SetProcAnimState, +0x34 slot 13 GetVelocity, +0x38 slot 14 UpdatePosition, +0x44 slot 17 PostLoad, +0x48 slot 18 ResolveObjectData, +0x14 slot 5 RenderDeferredEffects. Correction to the brief: slot 3 is RenderSimple; the re-pose-from-instance update is slot 14 UpdatePosition.
+0x0c is a POINTER to the CARP::Instance, not a copy (the RSceneObj.hpp comment 'a 64-byte record the constructor copies' is wrong; the ctor only copies it to a stack matrix).

The 64-bit effect masks (+0x20/+0x28/+0x30/+0x38), numEffects (+0x1f) and effect array (+0x14) belong to RAnimEngine::Handle (this->animHandle), not RSceneObj; SuppressEffects' '+0x38' is animHandle+0x38. Handle is 0x40 bytes (operator_delete(h,0x40)) plus instance nodes at +0x40 stride 0x40.

The two ~RSceneObj: 0x905a0 is the real RSceneObj::~RSceneObj (called by RSceneObj::scalar_deleting_destructor, ~RSkeletalObj, ~ActWeapon). 0x1aa70 is a 5-byte JMP to 0x905a0 (body 0x1aa70-0x1aa74; the decompiler shows the target's body) called only by RAutonomousObj::scalar_deleting_destructor 0x1b180 and an ActWeapon ctor unwind. It is almost certainly RAutonomousObj::~RAutonomousObj, the compiler-made destructor that just tail-jumps to the base; PS2 has ~RAutonomousObj 0x118360 in ActWeapon's file, next to where Xbox puts it.

The two Load functions: 0x90a60 is RSceneObj::Load (PS2 0x1c7360: same callers ChangeCarType/Grenade/PBondCar/PHelicopter, same body: RegisterCallback ResolveData, URefCounter<RCARPFile>, LoadCARPFile, GroupLocateTag('Arti'), UseArticle). 0xbd030 is NOT RSceneObj: a __cdecl that writes 3 floats of inverse box/cylinder inertia (0.5/(m*0.25*(y^2+z^2)+m/12*(2h)^2), 1/(m/3*(..))) from mass and dimensions into its first argument. Callers ChangeCarType/PBondCar/ProcessPhysics point at physics setup code (rigid-body inverse inertia); rename it. The second PS2 Load overload 0x1c7488 (strcasecmp, no callers) seems not to exist on Xbox.

RSkeletalObj: 0xa0 bytes (RSkeletalObj::scalar_deleting_destructor 0x912d0 does FastFree(this,0xa0)); its only constructor caller is RVehicle::RVehicle (0x953e0), so it is only ever a base of RVehicle and has no FastAlloc tag of its own. Vtable 0x00191c78 overrides slots 0, 10, 14, 17.

RAutonomousObj: allocation sites confirm that it passes &this->+0x40 as the CARP::Instance& to RSceneObj's ctor after copying the identity matrix from *(0x1c4654). With the identity matrix the packed radius word is 1.0f, so &0x3ff==0 and UseInstanceList computes a radius from the bbox.

Xbox renderTypeIndex/variation/brightness/flags are separate bytes (MSVC byte ops); PS2 packs the same four into one 32-bit bitfield word at PS2 +0x18 (bits 0-7, 8-15, 16-23, 24-28), so the byte offsets still map +4.

Invented names with no PS2 accessor behind them: damageEffectZones (+0x22), effectDecayTime (+0x24), collisionInfo/SceneObjCollisionInfo (+0x38), name (+0x3c), flags bits 1 and 2, springEffectMask/springPrevPos/springPos in RSkeletalObj. +0x20 is named after PS2 GetDamagedZones, but on both builds TriggerFX type 10 (stimuli) writes it and type 9 (damage) writes +0x22, so the damaged/other split between the two ushorts is uncertain.
